decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with high-value creatures and then bringing them back into play for a powerful advantage. By using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead, the deck can cheat expensive creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play early in the game. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student adds further versatility to the strategy.

The main focus of the deck is to utilize the powerful reanimation spells such as Reanimate and Animate Dead to quickly bring back high-impact creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the opponent's strategies and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of card draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm helps to find the necessary pieces for the combo quickly. The mana base consists of fetch lands and dual lands to support the deck's color requirements.

This deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning effect. It uses cards like Entomb and Reanimate to accomplish this strategy, while also having disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student is used for card draw and filtering, while Brazen Borrower provides additional disruption. The deck aims to control the game early on and then overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for a powerful combo finish. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. The mix of creature threats like Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty, along with card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, creates a versatile and powerful strategy that can overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, generating an infinite loop that allows for a quick win condition using cards like Dread Return or Thassa's Oracle. With supplementary cards like Voice of Victory and Nadu, Winged Wisdom, the deck aims to protect the combo and maintain control of the game. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card advantage, while cards like Force of Will and Daze offer protection against disruption from the opponent. The deck is designed to quickly assemble the combo and win the game efficiently.

The core idea of this deck is to assemble a combination of artifacts, specifically Mystic Forge and cards that allow for untapping or reducing the cost of artifacts, to generate a powerful engine that can churn through the deck, cast spells for free, and potentially win the game on the spot. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Pithing Needle to control the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo. By leveraging the synergy between these cards, the deck aims to create overwhelming advantages and close out the game quickly.

This deck revolves around using the combo pieces of Nadu, Winged Wisdom, Nomads en-Kor, and Delighted Halfling to draw and discard cards repeatedly, before ultimately winning the game through a combination of card advantage and creature synergy. The deck also features disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces, along with versatile removal like Swords to Plowshares. The deck's mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to its colors. Overall, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and synergy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck utilizes a mix of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty to create a strong, resilient board presence. Additionally, the deck includes control elements like Brainstorm and Daze to help manipulate the hand and counter opponent's spells. Finally, it utilizes lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The key focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently control the game through the aggressive use of spells and creatures, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Brazen Borrower, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure, along with counter spells like Daze and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's plays, this deck aims to dictate the pace of the game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, and Cori-Steel Cutter allow for additional removal and damage to secure victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through control elements such as counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It aims to maintain board control and card advantage through cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Brainstorm. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Tamiyo and Narset provides additional card advantage and utility. The deck also includes a mix of land destruction with Back to Basics and Hullbreacher to slow down aggressive strategies. The goal is to outvalue and outplay the opponent while controlling the game state to secure a victory.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while also presenting a fast clock with aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from casting their spells effectively, while also being able to close out the game quickly with powerful threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to deploy its threats ahead of schedule.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to draw through the deck and find key pieces like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Green Sun's Zenith. Delighted Halfling helps protect the combo, while cards like Endurance and Swords to Plowshares provide interaction with the opponent. The deck also includes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further support the combo strategy. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly cycle through your library and put all your cards into your graveyard in order to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. By using a combination of creatures like Boggart Trawler and Balustrade Spy, along with spells like Dark Ritual and Pact of Negation, you aim to fill your graveyard with creatures and spells as fast as possible. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to help protect your combo and interact with your opponent's game plan.

This Combo - Oops, All Spells! deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard and win the game in one explosive turn by leveraging powerful tutors and graveyard recursion spells. By utilizing cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the entire library, the deck can win by either triggering Thassa's Oracle or overwhelming the opponent with creatures like Boggart Trawler. With a suite of fast mana sources and disruption spells, this deck aims to win before the opponent has a chance to react, making it a high-risk, high-reward strategy in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The concept of this deck is to have a strong aggro strategy while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruptive creatures and removal spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition, while also controlling the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Thoughtseize. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides extra value and allows for more flexibility in the deck's strategy. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive threats and disruptive elements.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. The combination of fast graveyard filling, reanimation, and disruption allows the deck to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and control elements.
